integrity: The infinite statement is proved by an exact case split on the two spine labels and the induced page-sum constraints. Literature comparisons distinguish the Cartesian-product book family from join, ladder, and complete-multipartite families.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies the minimum layer only for book graphs with n at least 3; it does not claim a full signed-Roman weight enumerator, and finite computation is used only as a consistency check.
title: Minimum signed Roman dominating functions of book graphs
